evidence_boundary.interpretation_rule: missing componentwise or integrated evidence must not be inferred from maxima

facts.current_richards_temporal_error: binary 0 for exact equality of relevant final state, huge(real64) otherwise

qualification_boundary: No production Richards temporal-error metric is admitted by this characterization step.
No arbitrary cross-unit normalization is admitted.
No F-PE threshold, BALANCED, THROUGHPUT, FALLBACK, iteration cap, or physics change is admitted.
Non-monotone delta behavior is characterization evidence rather than a test failure.

F-PE remains blocked until the F-MR16 owner/theory decision is closed and any required model-owned metric work, F-MR composition, independent F-VQ, and accepted nontrivial Richards runtime are complete.
